text:
marie: FYI opened a small PR to align the pricing examples and add a short billing reconciliation note for burst credits.
josh: Can you paste the PR link? I want to update the docs snippet tests.
marie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5231 — merges steady-tier table + burst-credit callout and adds an example of how burst usage appears in exports.
rita: For the SDK snippet, include both explicit header and SDK option (py/requests + node fetch). Also call out exact SDK versions that normalize quota headers.
luis: Small ask: add a PromQL migration line for the token metric rename and a grep/sed one-liner so infra can bulk-update dashboard JSONs.
marie: Done — doc says rename redwood.rate.tokens.total -> redwood.token.count and suggests `git grep -l "redwood.rate.tokens.total" | xargs sed -i 's/redwood.rate.tokens.total/redwood.token.count/g'`. Also included example `sum(rate(redwood.token.count[5m])) by (model,tier)`.
ci-bot: docs CI OK — linkcheck passed, snippet tests passed.
josh: I'll review copy and then regenerate grafana snapshots after merge. Thanks!
